definition: daily spread = mean of the k highest prices minus mean of the k lowest, k=4 half-hours, which is roughly the depth this 2-hour asset moves in one direction per cycle
finding: the median forecast's daily spread averages 40.51 against a realised 64.84 (ratio 0.625), and its day-to-day standard deviation is 0.251 of the realised one. Persistence, a worse forecast by MAE but an actual price path, is undistorted at 1.0 and 1.0 — so the compression is a property of conditional-mean forecasting, not of forecasting
